verses.7:107: فَأَلۡقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ ثُعۡبَانࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
verses.26:32: فَأَلۡقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ ثُعۡبَانࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏

meaning: The root ثعب (thEb) refers to the outflow or outpouring of water. A مثعب (math'ab) is an outlet, channel, or conduit for water, such as from a watering-trough, tank, or rooftop.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic root occurring exactly twice.
